boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Kentucky
boards.description: Ten currently listed food destinations with late availability in and around the University of Kentucky area.

cards.title: WOW American Eats at Holmes Hall
cards.subtitle: Holmes Hall, University of Kentucky
cards.notes: Use the Holmes Hall counter for a North Campus food option when you need something after most student-center dining has closed.
cards.short_summary: A campus-based comfort-food counter with Sunday–Thursday midnight hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UK states that WOW American Eats in Holmes Hall is open 11 a.m.–midnight Sunday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: WOW American Eats gives UK’s campus a new dining option
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 11 a.m.–midnight Sunday through Thursday; Friday hours end at 5 p.m. and it is closed Saturday.

cards.title: Naz’s Halal Food on South Limestone
cards.subtitle: 685 S Limestone, Lexington, KY 40508
cards.notes: Check the location page before heading out; its listed daily and weekend closing times make it a practical late food stop by campus.
cards.short_summary: Halal counter service on South Limestone with especially late Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Naz’s official Lexington location page lists hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 10:30 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Mad Mushroom on South Broadway
cards.subtitle: 561 S Broadway, Lexington, KY 40508
cards.notes: Use the store page to match your visit to its day-specific closing time, then order pizza, grinders, calzones, or sides.
cards.short_summary: A South Broadway pizza shop whose schedule extends into early morning on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Mad Mushroom’s Lexington page lists closing at 1 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: until 1 a.m. Monday–Wednesday, 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday, and midnight Sunday.

cards.title: Raising Cane’s on South Upper Street
cards.subtitle: 544 S Upper Street, Lexington, KY 40508
cards.notes: For a campus-edge pickup, consult the location’s dine-in and drive-thru schedule, which both run past midnight every day.
cards.short_summary: A South Upper Street chicken-finger restaurant with 1 a.m. weekday operation.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists this 544 S Upper Street location as open until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane’s in Lexington, KY – 544 S Upper Street
cards.access_notes: Both dine-in and drive-thru are listed until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Raising Cane’s on Harrodsburg Road
cards.subtitle: 2030 Harrodsburg Road, Lexington, KY 40504
cards.notes: Use this west-of-campus location when you need a late drive-thru or dine-in option; confirm the day before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Harrodsburg Road location with midnight and 2 a.m. listed closings.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists its 2030 Harrodsburg Road restaurant as open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane’s in Lexington, KY – 2030 Harrodsburg Rd
cards.access_notes: Both dine-in and drive-thru are listed until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Papa Johns Pizza – Avenue of Champions
cards.title: Papa Johns on Avenue of Champions
cards.subtitle: 265A Avenue of Champions, Lexington, KY 40508
cards.notes: Choose delivery or carryout from this campus-area store and use its posted day-by-day hours to time a late pizza order.
cards.short_summary: A campus-area pizza location listed through midnight on most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists its Avenue of Champions location open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday for delivery and carryout.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza Avenue Of Champions
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout are listed until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Papa Johns on Southland Drive
cards.subtitle: 123 Southland Drive, Lexington, KY 40503
cards.notes: Plan around the weekend schedule if you are south of campus; the official page offers both delivery and carryout ordering.
cards.short_summary: A Southland Drive pizza stop with Friday and Saturday midnight service.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists its Southland Drive location open until midnight Friday and Saturday for delivery and carryout.
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout are listed until 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Waffle House on South Broadway
cards.subtitle: 859 South Broadway, Lexington, KY 40504
cards.notes: Keep this South Broadway diner in mind for any-hour food; the official Lexington location directory lists it as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Waffle House on South Broadway near the campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House’s official Lexington directory lists Waffle House #1565 at 859 South Broadway as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Waffle House Locations in Lexington, KY
cards.access_notes: The official Lexington directory lists this location as “Open 24 hours.”

cards.title: Waffle House on Richmond Road
cards.subtitle: 2740 Richmond Road, Lexington, KY 40517
cards.notes: For a farther-east late meal, use the location page’s directions and verify travel plans; its schedule is listed as 24 hours daily.
cards.short_summary: A Richmond Road Waffle House that publishes 24-hour daily operation.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House lists Waffle House #1408 at 2740 Richmond Road as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The location page lists “Monday - Sunday 24 hours.”

cards.title: Goodfellas Pizzeria on Mill Street
cards.subtitle: 110 N Mill Street, Lexington, KY 40507
cards.notes: Use the counter-service pizza stop downtown when the later Thursday–Saturday schedule fits; check the location page before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza counter with 3 a.m. hours Thursday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Goodfellas’ Mill Street location lists hours until 3 a.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are until 11 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named University of Kentucky spaces for studying, collaboration, recreation, and student services.

cards.title: William T. Young Library
cards.subtitle: 401 Hilltop Avenue
cards.notes: Choose a floor to match the task: the library lists quiet, conversational, and collaborative zones plus reservable study rooms.
cards.short_summary: A central campus library with study settings ranging from open seating to reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Libraries identifies Young Library as the central library and lists open seating, study rooms, social spaces, computer labs, and wellness spaces.
cards.source_title: William T. Young Library | UK Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours before going; the page provides a daily hours link.

cards.title: Young Library’s Second Floor
cards.subtitle: William T. Young Library
cards.notes: Bring a group project to the University Wing whiteboards, reserve a room, or use the long tables in the Alumni Commons Wing.
cards.short_summary: A named library floor configured for group work and shared tables.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Libraries says the second floor has reservable study rooms, collaborative whiteboards in the University Wing, and long tables in the Alumni Commons Wing.
cards.source_title: Young Library Spaces & Technology | UK Libraries
cards.access_notes: The library reports a basement renovation beginning May 11, 2026; this second-floor space is separately described.

cards.entity_name: The Hub at W.T. Young Library
cards.title: The Hub at W.T. Young
cards.subtitle: William T. Young Library
cards.notes: Use this library-based support location when you need technology help, coaching, placement testing, or communication-assignment support.
cards.short_summary: A library hub that combines student technology help with academic-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: UK identifies Student Tech Help at The Hub in W.T. Young Library; Student Success also lists services in The Hub, including Presentation U.
cards.source_title: Information Services | University of Kentucky Information Technology Services
cards.access_notes: Service availability may vary; consult the linked support information before visiting.

cards.title: The Study Central
cards.subtitle: Hilary J. Boone Center, 500 Rose Street
cards.notes: Use the tutoring floor between classes, then return for peer tutoring or supplemental-instruction sessions when your course is listed.
cards.short_summary: A Boone Center academic-support space with tutoring, coaching, and scheduled study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Success locates The Study Central in the Boone Center and lists it for peer tutoring, supplemental instruction, and success coaching.
cards.source_title: The Study Drop-In Tutoring Schedule | Student Success
cards.access_notes: Check the course-by-course schedule before going; listed drop-in offerings vary by day and location.

cards.title: The Study North
cards.subtitle: Jewell Hall, 344 Martin Luther King Blvd.
cards.notes: Use the Jewell Hall tutoring floor for focused work, then match your class with the current drop-in tutoring schedule.
cards.short_summary: A bottom-level Jewell Hall study and peer-tutoring location.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Success locates The Study North in Jewell Hall and states that students may use its tutoring floor to study before tutors arrive.
cards.source_title: Peer Tutoring at The Study | Student Success
cards.access_notes: The official tutoring page lists current operating times and notes that offerings can change by term.

cards.title: The Study South
cards.subtitle: Pigman Hall, formerly Woodland Glen III
cards.notes: Use this large-classroom study location when its peer tutoring or Presentation U support fits the assignment you are working on.
cards.short_summary: A Pigman Hall academic-support space for tutoring and communication help.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Success identifies The Study South as a large classroom in Pigman Hall and lists peer tutoring and Presentation U there.
cards.access_notes: Confirm service schedules with Transformative Learning before making a special trip.

cards.title: The Social Staircase
cards.subtitle: Gatton Student Center
cards.notes: Use the central staircase as a meeting point or a place to pause between classes; it is explicitly designed as a gathering space.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located Student Center gathering area with campus-specific architectural details.
cards.evidence_claim: UK describes the Social Staircase, located in the center of Gatton Student Center, as an ideal space to gather.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Gatton Student Center; building access follows current Student Center operations.

cards.title: Cats Den Game Room
cards.subtitle: Gatton Student Center, first floor
cards.notes: Bring your WildCard ID to check out a game, then return all pieces by the end of the day before leaving the Cats Den.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor Student Center game room with board games, cards, billiards equipment, and a Nintendo Switch.
cards.evidence_claim: Gatton Student Center states that students, faculty, and staff can check out games with a WildCard ID and must return them by day’s end.
cards.access_notes: Game checkout requires a WildCard ID; games must remain in the Cats Den and be returned the same day.

cards.title: The Innovation Space
cards.subtitle: The Cornerstone, 401 S. Limestone St.
cards.notes: Plan a tabling event, roundtable, or social event here, and submit a reservation request through the University’s event system.
cards.short_summary: An open-concept Cornerstone venue for tabling, meetings, and social events.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Esports describes the Innovation Space at The Cornerstone as an open-concept space for tabling events, roundtable meetings, and social events.
cards.source_title: Reservations at The Cornerstone | University of Kentucky Esports
cards.access_notes: Reservations are requests rather than guarantees; the official page lists Cornerstone hours and reservation guidance.

cards.title: UKFCU Esports Lounge
cards.subtitle: The Cornerstone, 401 S. Limestone St.
cards.notes: Use the lounge for casual or competitive gaming, and review membership options or scheduled programming before you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A Cornerstone gaming space with equipment and games for casual and competitive play.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Esports states that the UKFCU Esports Lounge provides equipment and games for casual or competitive play and is located at The Cornerstone.
cards.source_title: Our Program | University of Kentucky Esports
cards.access_notes: The official program page says lounge access uses monthly membership passes; check current availability and terms before visiting.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission ways to spend time together at UK’s Arboretum and Art Museum.

cards.title: Browse the UK Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Singletary Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Meet at the front desk, register on arrival, then take time with the temporary exhibitions and permanent collection together.
cards.short_summary: A free museum visit inside the Singletary Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The UK Art Museum states that all admission is free and visitors register at the front desk upon arrival.
cards.source_title: UK Art Museum | College of Fine Arts
cards.access_notes: Located in the Singletary Center for the Arts, 405 Rose Street; follow the museum’s current visitor guidance.

cards.title: Walk the native-plant collection
cards.subtitle: The Arboretum, 500 Alumni Drive
cards.notes: Start at the Visitor Center and follow the paved route through Kentucky landscapes; bring water and stay on marked paths.
cards.short_summary: A two-mile route through native plants from Kentucky’s regions.
cards.evidence_claim: UK identifies Walk Across Kentucky as an Arboretum feature, and states that admission to The Arboretum is free.
cards.access_notes: The grounds are open daily from dawn to dusk. This excludes the separately ticketed Kentucky Children’s Garden.

cards.title: Take the half-mile Woods trail
cards.subtitle: Walk Across Kentucky, The Arboretum
cards.notes: Use the half-mile trail for a slower group walk, pausing to spot trees and wildflowers while protecting the understory.
cards.short_summary: A remnant Inner Bluegrass woodland with a marked trail.
cards.evidence_claim: UK describes the Arboretum Woods as part of the free-admission Arboretum and provides a half-mile trail through it.
cards.access_notes: Remain on the trail as requested by The Arboretum; grounds are open dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Wander the Horticultural Gardens
cards.subtitle: The Arboretum, 500 Alumni Drive
cards.notes: Choose a few garden rooms, compare seasonal planting ideas, and keep the conversation moving along the garden paths.
cards.short_summary: A collection of smaller gardens around the Visitor Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UK lists the Horticultural Gardens as an Arboretum feature and states that admission to The Arboretum is free.
cards.access_notes: Use the Arboretum grounds rather than the separately paid Kentucky Children’s Garden.

cards.title: Compare ideas in the Home Demonstration Garden
cards.subtitle: Horticultural Gardens, The Arboretum
cards.notes: Walk through the themed garden rooms together and pick one planting detail or landscape idea to discuss or photograph.
cards.short_summary: A four-acre set of themed garden rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UK identifies the Home Demonstration Garden within the free-admission Arboretum’s Horticultural Gardens.
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum and Visitor Center have free admission; grounds are open dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Pause in the Memorial Rose Garden
cards.subtitle: Horticultural Gardens, The Arboretum
cards.notes: Follow the cobblestone walk and take a quiet moment with the rose-covered pergolas and memorial artwork; treat it as a reflective stop.
cards.short_summary: A memorial garden with roses, pergolas, and a bird sculpture.
cards.evidence_claim: UK identifies the Flight 5191 Memorial Rose Garden as part of the free-admission Arboretum’s Horticultural Gardens.
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum and Visitor Center have free admission; grounds are open dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Follow the Fragrance Garden paths
cards.subtitle: Horticultural Gardens, The Arboretum
cards.notes: Walk the winding trails beneath climbing roses and compare the herbs, lavender, and fruit trees as you make an unhurried loop.
cards.short_summary: A scented garden of roses, lavender, herbs, and fruit trees.
cards.evidence_claim: UK identifies the Fragrance Garden as part of the free-admission Arboretum’s Horticultural Gardens.
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum and Visitor Center have free admission; grounds are open dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Look for seasonal changes in the Perennial Teaching Garden
cards.subtitle: Horticultural Gardens, The Arboretum
cards.notes: Make this a short observation stop: notice plant colors and textures, then share one detail each person wants to remember.
cards.short_summary: One of the smaller named gardens in the horticultural collection.
cards.evidence_claim: UK lists the Perennial Teaching Garden among the smaller gardens in the free-admission Arboretum’s Horticultural Gardens.
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum and Visitor Center have free admission; grounds are open dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Find Witch Hazel Dell
cards.subtitle: Horticultural Gardens, The Arboretum
cards.notes: Use the garden paths to locate this named stop, then slow down for a few minutes of conversation away from the main route.
cards.short_summary: A named dell within the Arboretum’s garden collection.
cards.evidence_claim: UK lists Witch Hazel Dell among the smaller gardens in the free-admission Arboretum’s Horticultural Gardens.
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum and Visitor Center have free admission; grounds are open dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Cross the wetland boardwalk
cards.subtitle: Walk Across Kentucky, The Arboretum
cards.notes: Head to the boardwalk, island, and ephemeral pool area for a nature-focused group stroll; use care if paths are wet.
cards.short_summary: A wetland exhibit along Walk Across Kentucky.
cards.evidence_claim: UK identifies the Mississippi Embayment wetland exhibit within Walk Across Kentucky at the free-admission Arboretum.
cards.access_notes: The grounds are open daily from dawn to dusk; use marked paths and plan for uneven or muddy conditions when applicable.

cards.source_title: Young Library Spaces & Technology | UK Libraries

cards.entity_name: William T. Young Library East Balcony

cards.entity_name: William T. Young Library Fourth Floor Cubbies

cards.subtitle: William T. Young Library · Fourth Floor
cards.notes: Choose a cubby overlooking the floor below for a personal work block, or use it with a small group while respecting the quieter floor setting.

cards.entity_name: William T. Young Library Fifth Floor Silent Reading Rooms
cards.title: Fifth Floor Silent Reading Rooms
cards.subtitle: William T. Young Library · Fifth Floor
cards.notes: Plan a solo reading or writing session in a silent Reading Room and keep devices muted; the entire fifth floor is designated for quiet study.
cards.short_summary: Two silent rooms within Young Library’s fully quiet fifth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Libraries states that Young Library’s Fifth Floor is designated for quiet study and includes two silent Reading Rooms.
cards.access_notes: Fifth Floor of William T. Young Library; maintain quiet-study conditions.

cards.title: Thomas D. Clark Graduate Study
cards.subtitle: William T. Young Library · Fifth Floor
cards.notes: Graduate students can use this fifth-floor study space for focused work; confirm current library access and any applicable graduate-student requirements before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A named fifth-floor study space designated for graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Libraries identifies the Thomas D. Clark Graduate Study on Young Library’s Fifth Floor as available to graduate students.
cards.access_notes: Available to graduate students on the Fifth Floor of William T. Young Library.

cards.entity_name: Lucille Caudill Little Fine Arts & Design Library Second Floor Study Rooms
cards.title: Fine Arts Second Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Lucille Caudill Little Fine Arts & Design Library
cards.notes: Reserve a second-floor room when your project needs a table, whiteboard, and contained group workspace; room capacities range from six to 14 seats.
cards.short_summary: Seven reservable rooms designed for group projects in the Fine Arts & Design Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Libraries reports seven reservable Second Floor study rooms at the Fine Arts & Design Library, most with tables, chairs, whiteboards, and seating for six to 14.
cards.source_title: Fine Arts Library Spaces & Technology | UK Libraries
cards.access_notes: Seven rooms on the Second Floor are available by reservation.

cards.entity_name: Lucille Caudill Little Fine Arts & Design Library Patio Seating
cards.title: Fine Arts Library Patio Seating
cards.subtitle: Lucille Caudill Little Fine Arts & Design Library · Outside entrance
cards.notes: Take individual reading or a low-key working session outside at the library patio, then move indoors if weather or project needs change.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor seating immediately outside the Fine Arts & Design Library entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Libraries states that patio seating just outside the Fine Arts & Design Library entrance is available for outdoor study.
cards.source_title: Fine Arts Library Spaces & Technology | UK Libraries
cards.access_notes: Patio seating is outside the library entrance; weather-dependent.

cards.entity_name: Medical Center Library Basement Study Pods
cards.title: Medical Center Library Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Medical Center Library · Basement back hall
cards.notes: Use an outlet-equipped pod for independent laptop work; check building access first, since after-hours basement access is limited to enrolled health-sciences students.
cards.short_summary: Eighteen individual, outlet-equipped pods in the Medical Center Library basement.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Libraries lists 18 individual study pods with outlets along the Medical Center Library basement back hall.
cards.access_notes: After-hours basement badge access is available to students enrolled in the six health sciences colleges.

cards.title: Education Library Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Education Library · Dickey Hall Room 227
cards.notes: Settle into the area designated for quiet study when you need fewer conversations; the library also provides open seating for individual or small-group work.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study area inside the Education Library’s single main floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Libraries states that the Education Library in Room 227 of Dickey Hall has open seating and one corner dedicated to quiet study.
cards.source_title: Education Library Spaces & Technology | UK Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Room 227 on the Second Floor of Dickey Hall; library seating capacity is about 20 users.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented UK rituals and recurring campus traditions, from first-week events to graduation-season symbolism.

cards.title: Begin with K Week
cards.subtitle: University of Kentucky welcome tradition
cards.notes: Check the official K Week schedule before arriving; new undergraduates are expected to participate in the annual pre-semester program.
cards.short_summary: UK’s annual welcome-week tradition introduces new students to campus, organizations, and community.
cards.evidence_claim: UK describes K Week as one of its biggest annual traditions and says it occurs before the semester begins.
cards.access_notes: Program is for new undergraduate students; consult the official schedule for event details.

cards.title: Find your people at Campus Ruckus
cards.subtitle: K Week kickoff event
cards.notes: Use the event to meet registered student organizations and ask how to get involved; confirm the current listing through Student Activities Board channels.
cards.short_summary: Campus Ruckus is UK’s student-organization kickoff event within K Week.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Student Success calls Campus Ruckus the kickoff event for K Week and reports that student organizations host activities for incoming students.
cards.source_title: UK Tradition Campus Ruckus to Kick Off K Week | Student Success
cards.access_notes: Check Student Activities Board’s current BBNvolved information for timing and location.

cards.title: Support DanceBlue’s marathon
cards.subtitle: UK student dance-marathon tradition
cards.notes: Follow DanceBlue’s official updates to participate or support dancers; the event raises funds for pediatric cancer care at UK.
cards.short_summary: DanceBlue is UK’s no-sitting, no-sleeping dance marathon fundraiser.
cards.evidence_claim: UKNow identifies DanceBlue as a 24-hour, no-sitting, no-sleeping dance marathon supporting the DanceBlue Hematology/Oncology Clinic.
cards.access_notes: Participation and support options vary by year; use DanceBlue’s official channels for current details.

cards.entity_name: President James Kennedy Patterson Statue Right Foot
cards.title: Rub Patterson’s right foot
cards.subtitle: Patterson Office Tower tradition
cards.notes: Visit the statue before an exam if you want to take part in the campus superstition; it is a ritual, not a guarantee of any result.
cards.short_summary: A campus superstition ties rubbing President Patterson’s right foot to exam success.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Student Success says students rub the right foot of President Patterson’s statue to get an “A” on finals.
cards.access_notes: The statue is in front of the Patterson Office Tower, according to UKNow.

cards.title: Meet Bowman at Alumni Plaza
cards.subtitle: Wildcat Alumni Plaza photo tradition
cards.notes: Stop at the Wildcat Alumni Plaza sculpture for a photo, then compare it with Bowman’s lounging counterpart in the Gatton Student Center.
cards.short_summary: Bowman, UK’s Wildcat sculpture, anchors a recurring campus-photo ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Student Success specifically lists taking a photo on Bowman at Alumni Plaza and his Gatton Student Center counterpart as a UK tradition.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza access is generally visible from campus paths; respect the sculpture and other visitors.

cards.title: Sled the Willy T. Bowl when conditions allow
cards.subtitle: William T. Young Library Bowl winter tradition
cards.notes: When snow conditions permit, use appropriate winter gear and follow any campus safety guidance; UK identifies the Bowl as a student sledding spot.
cards.short_summary: Winter snow turns the lawn by William T. Young Library into a sledding tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Student Success lists sledding down the Bowl by Willy T. on a garbage-can lid or trash bag among its campus traditions.
cards.access_notes: Participate only when conditions and university guidance make it safe; no event schedule is implied.

cards.title: Come back for Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Annual alumni-and-football celebration
cards.notes: Watch the official Homecoming site for the year’s events and use it as a chance to connect with alumni, students, and campus partners.
cards.short_summary: UK’s Homecoming has welcomed alumni around an annual football-centered celebration since 1915.
cards.evidence_claim: UK’s Homecoming site says the celebration began in 1915 and has continued every year since.
cards.access_notes: Events and access vary annually; consult the official Homecoming program.

cards.title: Learn “On, On, U of K”
cards.subtitle: University fight song
cards.notes: Listen to the official recording and learn the refrain before a game or campus event so you can recognize the university fight song.
cards.short_summary: “On, On, U of K” is UK’s officially published fight song.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Kentucky traditions page labels “On, On U Of K” as the fight song and publishes its lyrics and recording.
cards.access_notes: Use the university’s official recording and lyrics page; event participation is optional.

cards.title: Say hello to the Wildcat
cards.subtitle: UK athletics and academic-event mascot tradition
cards.notes: If you see the mascot at a game or academic function, take a respectful photo and enjoy the performance without interrupting event operations.
cards.short_summary: The Wildcat mascot has been a UK fixture since the 1976–77 academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: UK says Gary Tanner originated the Wildcat mascot in 1976–77 and that the mascot continues to attend athletics and academic functions.
cards.access_notes: Appearances depend on event programming; no appearance is guaranteed.

cards.title: Walk through Alumni Commons’ gates
cards.subtitle: New-student-to-graduate symbolic walk
cards.notes: Notice the gates early in your UK experience, then look for the university’s graduate-walk communication when your own commencement approaches.
cards.short_summary: Students are encouraged to enter Alumni Commons as new students and exit as graduates.
cards.evidence_claim: UKNow says students are encouraged to walk through Alumni Commons’ gates as new students and walk out as graduates.
cards.access_notes: UKNow advises graduates to watch for university communication about the upcoming walk.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Kentucky, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented through campus spaces, arts, recreation, and a nearby public garden.

cards.title: Start at Gatton Student Center
cards.subtitle: First stop: campus community hub
cards.notes: Use the building map or information desk to orient yourself, then pick one useful destination inside before heading across campus.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a practical campus landmark that combines services, study space, dining, and student involvement.
cards.evidence_claim: UK describes Gatton Student Center as a hub for student involvement, entertainment, resources, conveniences, study, dining, and events.
cards.access_notes: Located at 160 Avenue of Champions. Check the center’s current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Choose a game at the Cats Den
cards.subtitle: Gatton Student Center, first floor
cards.notes: Bring your Wildcat ID, choose a board or card game, and return it in proper condition before the end of the day.
cards.short_summary: A casual indoor stop with weekly programs and free game checkout for eligible UK community members.
cards.evidence_claim: UK’s Office of Student Organizations and Activities says Cats Den hosts weekly programs and offers board games, card games, pool cues, and ping-pong paddles free for use in the space.
cards.source_title: Cats Den and Worsham Cinema Programming
cards.access_notes: Game checkout is listed Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–12 a.m.; Wildcat ID is required and games stay in Cats Den.

cards.title: Cross Patterson Plaza
cards.subtitle: A walk through UK’s academic core
cards.notes: Pause by the James Kennedy Patterson statue, then use the plaza as a waypoint for continuing toward the academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor landmark that helps connect the student center to the academic core.
cards.evidence_claim: UK’s self-guided tour identifies Patterson Plaza as the heart of campus and notes the James Kennedy Patterson statue there.
cards.source_title: University of Kentucky Self-Guided Tour Map
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public campus space; follow posted campus guidance and pedestrian routes.

cards.title: Find a seat at Young Library
cards.subtitle: 401 Hilltop Avenue
cards.notes: Pick a quiet, conversational, or collaborative zone that fits your plan, and stop at the circulation desk if you need help.
cards.short_summary: A central library stop with multiple study settings, technology, and student support services.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Libraries says Young Library has quiet, conversational, and collaborative study areas, reservable rooms, social spaces, computer labs, printing, and student support services.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s live hours page before going; some spaces and services may have separate availability.

cards.title: Look for fossils in the library limestone
cards.subtitle: Inside William T. Young Library
cards.notes: As you move through the building, look closely at the stone floors, stairs, walls, and pillars for fossil shapes.
cards.short_summary: Turn a library visit into a self-guided look at the fossils embedded in its limestone.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Libraries documents Mesozoic-era limestone with fossil remains in Young Library’s floors, central staircase, walls, and pillars.
cards.access_notes: Observe the building materials without touching or damaging surfaces; use the library’s current access guidance.

cards.title: Spend time with an exhibition
cards.subtitle: Inside Singletary Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Register at the front desk on arrival, then give one gallery enough time to look closely rather than rushing the whole museum.
cards.short_summary: A free campus museum visit with temporary exhibitions and a collection of about 5,000 objects.
cards.evidence_claim: The UK Art Museum states that all admission is free and that visitors register at the front desk on arrival.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Singletary Center at 405 Rose Street; check current museum hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Otis A. Singletary Center for the Arts
cards.title: Check the Singletary calendar
cards.subtitle: 405 Rose Street
cards.notes: Browse the current event listings and choose a performance that fits your schedule, confirming ticket and entry details before committing.
cards.short_summary: A campus performing-arts venue presenting music, dance, opera, comedy, film, and spoken-word programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Singletary Center says it presents orchestral, choral, jazz, electronic, traditional, and rock music, plus dance, opera, comedy, film, and spoken-word performances.
cards.source_title: Otis A. Singletary Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Event admission and availability vary; consult the specific event listing and ticket information.

cards.title: Plan a SkyTalk evening
cards.subtitle: Parking Structure No. 2, 301 Hilltop Avenue
cards.notes: Check the observatory’s public-night details, then attend the astronomy talk and telescope viewing only if weather permits.
cards.short_summary: A campus observatory that welcomes the public to monthly astronomy talks and telescope viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: UK says MacAdam Student Observatory welcomes the public to monthly SkyTalks on the second Thursday, followed by observatory viewing when weather permits.
cards.access_notes: Public access is for scheduled public nights; consult the observatory for current details and weather-related changes.

cards.title: Move at Seaton Gym
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation summer option
cards.notes: Check facility hours and eligibility first, then choose a simple activity that leaves time and energy for the rest of your weekend.
cards.short_summary: A current Campus Recreation option while the Johnson Center is closed for summer construction.
cards.evidence_claim: UK Campus Recreation reports that Johnson Center is closed for summer 2026 and Seaton Gym is open and available for use.
cards.access_notes: Check facility hours and access requirements before arriving; UK states recreation facilities have eligibility rules.

cards.title: End outside on Walk Across Kentucky
cards.subtitle: The Arboretum, 500 Alumni Drive
cards.notes: Follow the paved paths through the native-plant collection, bring water, and allow extra care where the route leaves pavement or turns muddy.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor finish through a Kentucky native-plant collection at UK’s State Botanical Garden.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum identifies Walk Across Kentucky as a diverse native-plant collection and states that Arboretum admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit The Arboretum, State Botanical Garden of Kentucky
cards.access_notes: Arboretum grounds are open daily from dawn to dusk. The Kentucky Children’s Garden is separate and has paid admission.

warnings: Hours, event schedules, recreation eligibility, and access conditions can change; confirm them on the linked official pages before visiting.
